fields.label: Menu Icon
fields.name: menu_icon
fields.instructions:
This image/logo will replace the menu item with the class "menu-logo-item" in the navigation (Appearance > Menu > Main Menu).

It will not appear if there are 0 menu items with this class.

It is recommended that this image be a .svg or .webp file with a transparent background).

fields.label: Menu Icon Mobile
fields.name: menu_icon_svg
fields.instructions:
This icon will replace the menu title if it is added.
It is recommended that this image be a .svg file.

fields.label: Open Graph Message
fields.message: Your Open Graph information consists of text and often an image. This information is what Google, Facebook and other Search Engines and Social Media entities use to show more details about your website's domain/url.

fields.label: Open Graph Title
fields.name: open_graph_title
fields.instructions: Add a title for Open Graph (sharing details).

fields.label: Open Graph URL
fields.name: open_graph_url
fields.instructions: Add the expected final URL for the website's homepage for Open Graph (sharing details).

fields.label: Open Graph Image
fields.name: open_graph_image
fields.instructions: Add an image for Open Graph. Make sure to add this at the production level image's URL is the same as your website.

fields.label: Tours Filter?
